_metadata.description: OS-agnostic control plane with capability-reported adapters.

requirements.title: Adapters report capabilities before actions are offered
requirements.description: The scenario shall route host, resolver, router, and manual operations through adapters that report supported actions, required privileges, rollback support, platform identity, and unsupported reasons before UI, CLI, or optimization flows offer the action.

validation.notes: `TestEndpointDescriptorsMatchAdapterRPCPayloads` and `TestConnectAdapterEndpointsReturnTypedResponses` cover exact adapter RPC metadata, manual-router explanation, platform summary, and unconfigured/configured AdGuard capability reporting at the Connect boundary. `internal/adapters/service_test.go` covers Linux/macOS/Windows/manual profiles and the resolver-aware registry. The broader fake OS/router adapter matrix and full requirements gate remain planned.
